title: Answer Context Highlight QA
principle: Receipt drill-downs should leave the user at the relevant control with a clear, safe reminder of the answer context they came from.
public_repo_rule: Highlights store only metadata: message id, target panel, model/route labels and context status. They store no prompts, no responses and no provider secrets.

scenarios.expected: Memory drill-down writes a local highlight and renders the receipt context in the Memory panel.
Knowledge drill-down writes a local highlight and renders the receipt context in the Knowledge panel.
Model drill-down highlights the model and route labels behind the answer.
Privacy drill-down opens local export/delete controls with the same safe context metadata.
